entities.name: Radoslav of Serbia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rodosthlabos, usually rendered as Radoslav (Serbian: Радослав, or Rodoslav, was a Serbian Prince who ruled over the early medieval Principality of Serbia at the beginning of the 9th century. He succeeded his father, prince Višeslav, who ruled at the end of the 8th century. Radoslav was succeeded by his son, prince Prosigoj.
